∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ (c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId), B.codec.decode (snap.canonicalBytes { value := c }) = Option.some (w.cells c)

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∃ r, w.head = Option.some (height, r)

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ (x : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId), (w.journal x).isSome = (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded x snap.model.journal).isSome

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ (l : Minidregg.Theory.ResourceCost.Lane), w.meter l = snap.model.available l

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, (∀ (c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId), B.codec.decode (snap.canonicalBytes { value := c }) = Option.some (w.cells c)) → (∀ (d : D), (w.spent d).isSome = Bool.true ↔ ∃ n, B.key n = d ∧ snap.model.consumed n = Bool.true) → (∀ (x : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId), (w.journal x).isSome = (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded x snap.model.journal).isSome) → (∃ r, w.head = Option.some (height, r)) → (∀ (l : Minidregg.Theory.ResourceCost.Lane), w.meter l = snap.model.available l) → (∀ (c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId), (w.retired c).isSome = B.codec.retires (snap.canonicalBytes { value := c })) → (∀ (c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId), w.parent c = Option.none) → Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ (c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId), w.parent c = Option.none

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ (c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId), (w.retired c).isSome = B.codec.retires (snap.canonicalBytes { value := c })

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ (d : D), (w.spent d).isSome = Bool.true ↔ ∃ n, B.key n = d ∧ snap.model.consumed n = Bool.true

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D) (H : Minidregg.Kernel.World.History R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableEvent D) {snap next : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.PinCoherent B H rootBytes → ∀ {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {t : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn R D}, Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Turn.ofIntent B H w intent = Except.ok t → t.charge = intent.exactCharge → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.execute Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Schedule.complete snap intent = Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.Outcome.accepted next → ∃ w', Minidregg.Kernel.World.World.admit H w t = Except.ok w' ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B next (height + 1) w'

{R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} → {D : Type} → {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} → Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes → Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId → Option (Minidregg.Kernel.World.Cell R)

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ (c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId), w.cells c = Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.cellsOf B snap c

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D} {H : Minidregg.Kernel.World.History R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableEvent D} {cells : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId → Option (Minidregg.Kernel.World.Cell R)} {retired : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId → Bool} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {t : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn R D}, Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Derived B H cells retired intent t → ∀ {w0 : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite}, w0 ∈ intent.writes → ∃ v, B.codec.decode w0.canonicalPostBytes = Option.some v

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (schedule : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Schedule) (before : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes) (intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes), Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.Installs (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.execute schedule before intent) = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded intent.transactionId before.model.journal = Option.none ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent.preflight before intent = Except.ok () ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.Outcome.storeAfter before (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.execute schedule before intent) = before.install intent ∨ Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.Installs (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.execute schedule before intent) = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.Outcome.storeAfter before (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.execute schedule before intent) = before

∀ {c : Minidregg.Kernel.World.CellId} {ws : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot.lookupPostBytes { value := c } ws = Option.none → c ∉ Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.writeIds ws

∀ {c : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId} {ws : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite} {b : List UInt8}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot.lookupPostBytes c ws = Option.some b → ∃ w0 ∈ ws, w0.cellId = c ∧ w0.canonicalPostBytes = b

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D) (H : Minidregg.Kernel.World.History R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableEvent D) {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.PinCoherent B H rootBytes → ∀ {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {t : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn R D}, Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Turn.ofIntent B H w intent = Except.ok t → t.charge = intent.exactCharge → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded intent.transactionId snap.model.journal = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent.preflight snap intent = Except.ok () → ∃ w', Minidregg.Kernel.World.World.step H w t = Option.some w' ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B (snap.install intent) (height + 1) w'

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D) (H : Minidregg.Kernel.World.History R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableEvent D) {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {t : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn R D}, Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Turn.ofIntent B H w intent = Except.ok t → t.charge = intent.exactCharge → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded intent.transactionId snap.model.journal = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent.preflight snap intent = Except.ok () → (∀ p ∈ t.pins, w.retired p.1 = Option.none ∧ H.cellDigest (w.cells p.1) = p.2) → ∃ w', Minidregg.Kernel.World.World.step H w t = Option.some w' ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B (snap.install intent) (height + 1) w'

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D) (H : Minidregg.Kernel.World.History R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableEvent D) {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.PinCoherent B H rootBytes → ∀ {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {t : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn R D}, Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Turn.ofIntent B H w intent = Except.ok t → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent.preflight snap intent = Except.ok () → (∀ wr ∈ intent.writes, H.cellDigest (w.cells wr.cellId.value) = B.pin wr.expectedPre) ∧ ∀ g ∈ intent.readGuards, H.cellDigest (w.cells g.cellId.value) = B.pin g.expectedRoot

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {before : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent.preflight before intent = Except.ok () → intent.nullifiers.Nodup ∧ (∀ n ∈ intent.nullifiers, before.model.consumed n = Bool.false) ∧ intent.exactCharge ≤ before.model.available

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D) (H : Minidregg.Kernel.World.History R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableEvent D) {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.PinCoherent B H rootBytes → Function.Injective B.pin → ∀ {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {t : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn R D}, Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Turn.ofIntent B H w intent = Except.ok t → ∀ {w' : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.World.World.admit H w t = Except.ok w' → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent.readGuardsMatchCheck snap intent = Bool.true ∧ ∀ wr ∈ intent.writes, snap.model.roots wr.cellId = wr.expectedPre

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {before : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent.preflight before intent = Except.ok () → (∀ wr ∈ intent.writes, before.model.roots wr.cellId = wr.expectedPre) ∧ ∀ g ∈ intent.readGuards, before.model.roots g.cellId = g.expectedRoot

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (records : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes), Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.replay rootBytes before records = Option.some after → after.model.journal = (List.map (fun r => (r.transactionId, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase r)) records).reverse ++ before.model.journal ∧ ∀ (n : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier), after.model.consumed n = (Decidable.decide (n ∈ List.flatMap Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord.nullifiers records) || before.model.consumed n)

∀ {R : Minidregg.Kernel.World.Registry} {D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq D] {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (B : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Bridge R D) (H : Minidregg.Kernel.World.History R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableEvent D) {snap next : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {height : ℕ} {w w' : Minidregg.Kernel.World.World R Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId D}, Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B snap height w → ∀ {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes} {t : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn R D}, Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.Turn.ofIntent B H w intent = Except.ok t → t.charge = intent.exactCharge → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.execute Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Schedule.complete snap intent = Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.Outcome.accepted next → Minidregg.Kernel.World.World.admit H w t = Except.ok w' → Minidregg.Kernel.HostRefinesWorld.SnapRepresents B next (height + 1) w'

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image} {bh : ℕ} {st : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.resume rootBytes image bh st = Option.some snap → snap.model.journal = (List.map (fun r => (r.transactionId, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase r)) image.accepted).reverse ∧ ∀ (n : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier), snap.model.consumed n = (Decidable.decide (n ∈ List.flatMap Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord.nullifiers (List.drop bh image.accepted)) || Decidable.decide (n ∈ List.flatMap Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord.nullifiers (List.take bh image.accepted)))
